$comment: The world's music: one song per scene, played on a loop while you're there. `file` is in sounds/. `lufs` is the song's integrated loudness (ffmpeg -i <file> -filter_complex ebur128 -f null -), so every scene plays at the same level. A scene with no song falls back to its generative loop. Songs in sounds/ whose name matches an album's `track` are played for that album instead of a preview.
